task.description:
Design the OIDC-10 (Attribute Synchronisation) implementation. The existing OIDC-09 design at src/design/oidc-09-jit-provisioning.md already defines the syncAttributesFromIdentityContext function signature and the high-level OIDC-10 requirements. Your job is to produce a focused design document at src/design/oidc-10-attribute-sync.md that covers:

1. Replace the stub syncAttributesFromIdentityContext function in src/oidc/jit_provisioning.zig with a real implementation that:
   - Updates display_name, email, status from token claims on every auth
   - Calls identity_service to update the local user record
   - Returns the updated User record

2. Role reconciliation design:
   - Token roles from IdentityContext.roles are authoritative for OIDC-sourced role bindings
   - Locally-assigned roles (from IDN-03) must be preserved
   - Define the reconciliation algorithm: read current user_roles, diff against token roles, insert/delete as needed, skip locally-assigned roles
   - Specify the identity_service function(s) needed for role reconciliation

3. Wiring into auth.zig:
   - After JIT provisioning, call syncAttributesFromIdentityContext on every auth
   - When to reconcile roles (after attribute sync)
   - Error handling: attribute sync failure should not block auth (best-effort but logged)

4. Any new DB queries or schema needed:
   - Query to read user profile fields for comparison
   - Query to update user profile fields
   - Query to manage role bindings (insert/delete OIDC-sourced roles)

5. Test strategy:
   - Unit tests for the sync function (in-memory)
   - Integration tests for the full attribute sync + role reconciliation flow

6. Open questions or risks

Reference: the OIDC-10 requirement text in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md (lines ~1561-1578).
acceptance_criteria: src/design/oidc-10-attribute-sync.md is created with all sections above
Every acceptance criterion from OIDC-10 maps to a concrete design element
Role reconciliation algorithm is clearly specified
Error handling strategy for sync failure is documented

result.summary: Design artefact for OIDC-10 Attribute Synchronisation and Role Reconciliation

issues.description: OQ-1: Role slug to role_id resolution uses subquery per slug; batch lookup may be needed for 100+ roles
OQ-4: IdentityContext does not carry status from token claims; status sync limited to default_status for now

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) for implementation and FRONTEND-DEV (Step 2b) — no frontend changes expected
